final_message: I parsed the log file by reading each entry line by line, identifying entries with level ERROR or CRITICAL (case insensitive). For each such entry, I converted the timestamp to UTC ISO format, extracted the service, level (uppercased), message, and the last line of any traceback. I also summed the repeat counts from any following repeat lines. I aggregated the counts by service. I wrote the resulting JSON structure to workspace/errors.json. The file is ready for review.
